description: Post-process module that ranks the chatters of the current stream by the points they have earned this stream. Records each user's first-seen score as a baseline (the engine enriches every message with the user's live total score), reports earned = current - baseline to the engine, and resets on a new stream (detected via the channel_viewers live edge). The TUI reads the cached ranking via the stream_leaderboard query.
name: stream-leaderboard
